labels.rationale: Usage question: Panel can be sized to its content with expand=False or Panel.fit(), documented in docs/source/panel.rst.

body:
Panels stretch to the full console width by default. To size a panel to its content, pass `expand=False` to the constructor, or create it with `Panel.fit(...)`. The [Panel docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/panel.rst) cover both.

For usage questions like this one, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
